committee.sub: Morning brief · Tuesday 29 September 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Spend eased to $128.87 from $156.45 with clicks down to 22 from 25 and CPC at $5.86, yet conversions stayed at zero. Post restart clicks sit at 71 of the 150 stop loss threshold, so the account is roughly halfway there with leads still at zero.

Sessions fell 32 percent to 40 from 59, and Direct dropped sharply to 7 from 21. That collapse lines up with the internal traffic filter cleaning out Chris's own visits rather than any real change in unpaid interest.

AI Assistant sessions held at 2 for the second week running, all from chatgpt.com, though this almost certainly undercounts real AI referred visits that land unlabelled in Direct. LinkedIn also showed 1 session against zero prior, worth tagging properly given Chris is posting there.

Calculator use dropped to 0 last7 from 1 prior7, and leads remain at zero, still just Chris's own test submissions. The AI automation landing page keeps pulling the most volume at 19 sessions, but nothing downstream is converting that traffic yet.

actions.text: Logo and image assets plus keyword matched RSA headlines for the currently serving ad groups are still outstanding, get these built and uploaded.
Fix the homepage form so kontrolTrackLead fires on the Formspree confirm rather than before it, the confirm then count logic is still not in place.
RSA description D1 still quotes 13.3 hours of admin per week, update it to match the current site stats before it runs any longer.
